run_zero_shot_classification_eval: run the ZeroShotClassificationEvaluator on ImageNet, CIFAR, and other datasets using configured prompt templates
configure_zero_shot_prompts: configure zero-shot classification prompt templates for datasets like ImageNet, Food101, and CIFAR-10
customize_evaluator_datasets: customize the datasets_and_prompts dictionary to add or modify prompt templates for new datasets
set_evaluator_image_size: set the image_size parameter on the ZeroShotClassificationEvaluator to resize input images
adjust_evaluator_workers: adjust the num_workers parameter on the ZeroShotClassificationEvaluator to control data loading parallelism
